subject: creating and deploying packages with shiny

messages.author: 2cb39c9f9ffdad3f
messages.subject: creating and deploying packages with shiny
parts:
Is there an example of how to create and deploy a package that includes the shiny app?   E.g. how do I include the ui.R and server.R files in the package ...etc

thanks.

messages.author: ca443e6eaa0e78ed
messages.subject: Re: creating and deploying packages with shiny
parts:
See the final section on this page:
http://rstudio.github.com/shiny/tutorial/#deployment-local

There's not an example there, but it should be like this:

+ mypackage/
    + inst
        + myapp
            - ui.R
            - server.R

And export this as part of your package:

runMyApp <- function() {
  shiny::runApp(system.file("myapp", package="mypackage"))
}
